senses.def: unknown god; an epithet of Prajapati and Brahma
The aspect of a person’s soul or being that sustains their existence, roughly the life-force, sometimes pictured as a double of the person.
ex: ‘You could bind the ka of a man to his body for five thousand years,’ said Jaquel.

senses.def: The name of the Cyrillic script letter К / к.
